name: Brady Quinn
strengths: Quinn gets the ball out on time from a compact platform — quick release into intermediate digs, crossers, and timing windows.
Quinn creates when the first look is covered: slides/extends in the pocket and still delivers with enough composure to finish the play.
Quinn shows touch over the middle and keeps chains moving on intermediate placement that lets receivers run after the catch.
weaknesses: Quinn can lock the first read and drop his eyes to the rush when the primary is covered — deep outs and sideline fades still need more drive from a 6-0 frame.
comparison: Quinn comps to Baker Mayfield — 6-0 create-timing mold who wins with processing, a quick release, and enough mobility to extend without becoming a pure runner (size-matched within ~1–2" of Quinn's 6-0 / 185).
projection: Quinn projects as develop into the QB room, compete for the job, then starter upside — never a rotational QB path. Ceiling: campus starter who wins with timing and create ability.
schemeFit: Quinn fits a timing / progression offense that values eyes, quick decisions, and create ability over pure prototype height.
insiderNotes: Quinn is the Chaminade-Madonna (Hollywood) 2028 QB after transferring from Lely (Naples). Tape is sophomore Lely highlights: compact platform, on-time intermediate game, create-to-throw. Florida offered with 2 UOVs; Miami leads On3 RPM ~24% with Florida ~21%. Contact heat is real — multiple programs stay consistent, and Florida remains in the live in-state chase.
